summary: The XSS flaw is in the bad sink in 67b, where untrusted data (read from a socket) is concatenated directly into the HTML error message passed to response.sendError. The fix HTML-encodes the data before output, neutralizing script-injection characters while preserving the feature of echoing the received value.

edits.old:
response.sendError(404, "
bad() - Parameter name has value " + data);
